description: Transactions signed by Bitcoin Core 32.1 with signrawtransactionwithkey on regtest, one for each kind of coin and hash type. Each spends two coins of the same output script and amount. Core's testmempoolaccept allowed every one of them.
source: Made for the security fixes of November 2026 with a private regtest node. The keys are the 32-byte secrets 0x11.., 0x22.. and 0x33.., known to everyone.
